input.prompt: Flat vector illustration for a website hero, in a clean modern corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, subtle grain texture on the large background blob, and simple geometric characters. Scene: on the left, a tall untidy stack of paper forms and bills piled on a small light blue desk, with a big blue umbrella-and-shield emblem floating above it and a tiny toy car and a tiny house icon beside it. The papers travel along a dotted periwinkle path into the centre, where a friendly rounded AI document scanner in white and periwinkle blue with a glowing beam reads a form through a magnifying-glass lens. Out of the right side, three neat cards fly along separate dotted branches: one plain card with abstract lines goes to a smiling woman in a mustard-yellow blouse working at a laptop, one card with a big green check mark goes to a man in a periwinkle shirt holding a tablet, and one card with a coin icon goes to a dashboard screen showing a bar chart and a small green stamp. A yellow lightbulb with sparkles and two pale yellow gears float in the background sky. Background: one large soft light-blue organic blob on a pure white background with a few flat pale clouds; no ground line, no floor, objects float within the blob. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, soft green #3BB273, dark navy line accents #1F2A44, white. Airy, balanced composition, wide 16:9 framing, clean white space around the blob. Absolutely no text of any kind: no captions under the people, no labels on cards, no lettering on documents, no word on the scanner, no word on the stamp; every form, card, stamp and screen shows only abstract lines, bars and blocks.
